notes: KEY DECISIONS / REUSE. (D1 settings hook wraps, does not fork) useDriverSettings is a thin useState+write-through over the EXISTING driverSettings.ts — setters call setSilentMode/setNavAppPreference so the same 'driver_silent_mode' + 'driver_nav_app' localStorage keys remain authoritative. B-offer's useOfferSound reads getSilentMode() directly and B-ride's navLinks read getNavAppPreference() directly; the hook never introduces a new key, so nothing goes out of sync. Added a NavApp type export to driverSettings.ts (shared by the hook + NavAppPreference component); no key/default changes. (D2 historyTotals skips non-completed) computeHistoryTotals only counts+sums status==='Completed'; A-me's GetMyOrders returns completed AND active rides, and active rides carry null finalPriceCzk/paymentType — summing them would NaN/miscount. Price defaulted via ?? 0 so a completed ride with null price contributes 0 not NaN. This is the discriminating test case. (D3 MyOrder envelope trap) Added getDriverMyOrders + MyOrder/GetDriverMyOrdersResponse to client.ts; the API returns { orders: [...] } (GetMyOrdersResponse.cs), so useMyOrders uses select: data => data.orders (the laneB11 CreateOrderResponse-shape trap). Query key hierarchical ['driver','orders',date]. (D4 logout enumerates all stores) DriverSettingsPage.handleLogout clears authStorage (localStorage tokens) + idbAuthStore (taxi-driver-auth) + transitionQueue (taxi-driver-queue) + idbRideStore (taxi-driver-ride) then navigate('/d/login'). Preference keys (nav app, silent mode) intentionally left — not session state. /d/login is outside the /d layout so DriverPositionReporter + DriverQueueBar unmount cleanly. (D5 app version via vite define) Added define { __APP_VERSION__: JSON.stringify(pkg.version) } to vite.config.ts (package.json import with { type: 'json' }) AND an identical define in vitest.config.ts ('0.0.1-test') because the test runner has its own config and would otherwise ReferenceError. Ambient 'declare const __APP_VERSION__: string' added to src/vite-env.d.ts so tsc passes. package.json version is 0.0.1. (D6 Diagnostika feature-detects browser APIs) Notification.permission and navigator.permissions are undefined in jsdom — both are guarded and fall back to an i18n'd 'Neznámo'. Location permission queried async with the optimistic/onchange pattern copied from DriverHomePage; lastPositionSent read from useOwnPositionStore (B-position writes lastSentAt on each successful hub send) and formatted Europe/Prague; SignalR state from useConnectionState. (D7 offline = DisconnectBanner) HistoryPage reuses the SignalR-keyed DisconnectBanner (the established last-known-state pattern), NOT navigator.onLine — reads keep working from the TanStack cache; only a disconnect shows the banner. (D8 money/date) No shared CZK/date helper exists; hand-rolled Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ') (integer CZK, no decimals) + toLocaleTimeString with timeZone 'Europe/Prague' at render only per web-react-style.md. (D9 nav) Minimal bottom NavLink bar (Domů/Historie/Nastavení) added to DriverLayout — within the /d group only; /x routes untouched. Routes /d/history + /d/settings added to router.tsx under the existing /d DriverLayout children. (D10 i18n) Added driver.nav.*, driver.history.*, driver.settings.* (incl. diagnostika + permission/connection maps) to BOTH cs.json + en.json; locales.parity green. (D11 a11y) All new interactive components (NavAppPreference radiogroup, SilentModeToggle labelled checkbox) carry an axe assertion; Diagnostika + HistoryPage + DriverSettingsPage also axe-clean. Touch targets: nav-app options + silent toggle row >=48px (touchTargets.min); logout button >=64px (touchTargets.primary). No api/** touched. Staged web/ only; never committed. No new npm packages.
